title: Overlaying group score histograms
description: You can inspect the filters, colors and threshold used in this plot.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You create one axis and loop over groups A and B. Each group receives an explicit color.
The row filter selects scores for the current group. hist draws those scores with the supplied bin count and a partially transparent fill.

steps.question: Does this line draw a separate selection threshold for each group?
steps.answer: No. It draws one vertical reference at the supplied threshold after the loop.

steps.description: You label the axes, add the supplied title and legend, and call show. The recording has no rendered chart or text output, so it supplies no distribution values to inspect.
